description: Ask one of your helpers (`list_helpers`) to do part of this turn's work, on its own model, and get its reply.
It works for the same person in this conversation, with its own tools, keys and
rules; nothing it writes is posted. Asking the same helper again continues its
conversation in this thread. `self`, when listed, is a fresh copy of you each time:
ask it several times without waiting to work in parallel. While `status` is
`queued` or `running`, call `wait_for_helpers` with the `ask_id`. Helpers stop when your turn ends, so wait
for their replies before you answer.
To pass it files: for each, call `create_file_upload_url`, PUT the file with the
curl it returns, and pass the handle id in `files`. Files the helper sends back
are in the answer's `files`: download one with `curl -sS -o <name> "<url>"`, or
pass its `id` to another helper's `files`. Deliver one to the person as you would
a file you made. The links expire an hour after the ask.

files.description: Handle ids of files to pass to the helper (see below).

helper.description: A helper's name or agent id from list_helpers.

message.description: Everything the helper needs: the task, the facts and what to send back. It can't see this conversation's history or files you don't pass.

wait.description: False to start it and ask other helpers before waiting.
